{"language":"sql","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dalani_current_org_id()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    SELECT COALESCE(
        to_jsonb(u)->>'organization_id',
        to_jsonb(u)->>'org_id'
    )
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          u.id::text = auth.uid()::text
          OR to_jsonb(u)->>'supabase_user_id' = auth.uid()::text
      )
    LIMIT 1;
$function$
","return_type":"text","security_definer":true,"security_invoker":false}
